content.ascii:
ControllerSnapshot - resolved state held by the controller
|
|-- contextId / canvasRevisionId / version / canUndo / canRedo
|-- endpointBounds / cell (geometry metadata)
|-- document: MappingGridDocument
|   |-- scene: LineGridScene
|   |   |-- root: GridBox
|   |   |   |-- id / position / minimumSize / collapsed / collapsedContentId
|   |   |   |-- Container: children: GridBox[] + collision layout
|   |   |   `-- Diagram instance: contentId -> scene.contents[contentId]
|   |   `-- contents[contentId]: immutable Diagram (exact revision)
|   |       |-- id: local key / diagramId: stable identity / revisionId: stored version
|   |       |-- content: ASCII, hash and parsed structure
|   |       |-- sourceContext
|   |       |   |-- Optional binding: source, repository, corpus, domain profile
|   |       |   |-- contentHash / mappings / evidence with source ranges
|   |       |   `-- -> diagramSource() joins region mappings to evidence ranges
|   |       `-- Optional highlights / jumps
|   |-- edges / jumps / sections
|   `-- alternatives / diagramPresentations / diagramContexts
|       revisionSelections / revisionReviews
|
`-- canvas: MappingCanvasState
    |-- selection: SelectionState
    |   `-- items[]: ordered membership, separate from focus and pane ownership
    |       |-- id / displayNodeId (no region = whole instance)
    |       `-- Optional region: captured ASCII, content/revision IDs, rect, node IDs
    |-- controls: MappingControls
    |   |-- activeBoxId / selectionFocusId / activeThreadId
    |   `-- surfaces[id]: prompt, ask, action and presentation control state
    |-- viewport / projectionLayout
    |-- display: DisplayState
    |   |-- rootIds + nodes[id]: FloatingPane; childIds encode pane ownership
    |   `-- Pane variants (each holds geometry, expansion and geometry policy)
    |       |-- SelectionRegion: captured panel context, not selection membership
    |       |-- ProjectedPane: call-tree / compaction / source-code / code-panel
    |       |-- ConversationPane: thread, draft, presentation, canvas anchor
    |       `-- DetailPane: title, ASCII, section
    `-- diagramViews[instanceId]: DiagramViewState
        |-- contentRevisionId / collapsedContentNodeIds / collapsedNodeRefs
        |-- regular or diff display / baseRevisionId
        `-- -> presentationScene(document) -> resolveDiagramView(scene, views)
            |-- Derived bounds and visible-row/raw-line mapping; ASCII unchanged
            `-- -> runtime shape projection (not another persisted scene)
